{
  "participants": [
    {

      "stance": "objection",

      "text": "split the PR into smaller, more focused commits or multiple PRs",

      "status_note": "author split the PR into separate commits",

      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312181120",
      "status_by_quote": "latest push removes each method in separate commits."

    {
      "id": "rc:3279624744",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "peel off each method separately such as getLogCategories/isAnyDebugLoggingEnabled before category-mask refactor",
      "quote": "I would prefer peeling off each method separately to have some progress during review.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author split removal of each method into separate commits",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312181120",
      "status_by_quote": "latest push removes each method in separate commits."

    {
      "id": "rc:3279693120",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "drop the string-parsing SetCategoryLogLevel overload with no production callers",
      "quote": "Could we drop it and have the test use the typed setter directly?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "overload removed and test updated to use typed setter",

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "rc:3312191254",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",

      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained parsing code was dropped from Logger class and kept Info for now",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312240789",
      "status_by_quote": "Following your other suggestion ... this -loglevel parsing code is now dropped from the logger class."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3280651475",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "split test save/restore plumbing into the commit where test fixtures need it",
      "quote": "Could it be split into the commit where the test fixtures first need to snapshot the level masks?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author split the snapshot helper into the commit where test fixtures need it",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312246006"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312246006",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, this should be done now."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3281289661",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "setting -loglevel unintentionally enables a log category without -debug being set",
      "quote": "Previously, setting a category level at startup stored the override, but it had no visible effect unless the category was also enabled with -debug. Here, setting `-loglevel=net:trace` appears to enabl",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed by only updating levels of previously enabled categories",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312272744",
      "status_by_quote": "It's fixed by making `-loglevel` only update the levels of previously enabled categories."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3288013785",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "confusing design that forces conditional categories and unconditional logging levels into the same model",
      "quote": "Seems we have two fundamentally different ways of logging that we're forcing together here... I find this design confusing for multiple reasons",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "changed array declaration and added comment to make this clearer",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312391409"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312391409",
      "status_by_quote": "changed array declaration and added comment to make this clearer"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3288138282",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "whether category check taking different branch for info vs debug is an optimization or redundant code smell",
      "quote": "This seems like a code smell (even though it was similar before). Wouldn't the categories already return the same value here - Is this an optimization?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "improved in push",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312451111"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312451111",
      "status_by_quote": "Yeah agree this could be better, should be improved now but let me know."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3288806782",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "make loop dual behavior in SetCategoryLogLevel more obvious in code instead of needing header explanation",
      "quote": "This loop has dual behavior that needed extra explanation in the header. Maybe we could make it more obvious via code instead",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author added comment and explained why current loop structure is simpler",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312486910"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312486910",
      "status_by_quote": "I added a comment here to be clearer, and I'm open to feedback on different ways to write this, but I feel like the current version is actually simpler than the suggestions"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3289031399",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "add a test covering the runtime-enable path when startup configured category at Trace",
      "quote": "Could we add a test that goes through this runtime-enable path after startup configured the category at Trace?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "tests added covering runtime-enable behavior",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312498305"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:4374002528",
      "status_by_quote": "adding new tests commits before changes to cover more behaviors"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3289092797",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "deduplicate libevent enabled check when updating HTTP server logging",
      "quote": "We can probably deduplicate this:",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author applied suggestion",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312499937"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312499937",
      "status_by_quote": "Make sense, appied suggestion"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3289129041",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "kernel logging API changes behavior by enabling a category when setting its level",
      "quote": "Previously, setting a category level did not enable the category. Now it looks like setting the level also enables it. Should we adjust this to match the old behavior?",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author explained rationale and adjusted kernel logging behavior",
      "author_replies": ["rc:3312551897"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3312551897",
      "status_by_quote": "In this case I think the new behavior is probably better as there is no point to kernel code setting a level for a categ"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Brought record up to date under current rules. Converted non-harm review requests to suggestions and recorded unlisted suggestions and questions from l0rinc; PR is awaiting re-review following author's updates and rebases.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review from l0rinc after commits split, test coverage added, and rebased",
      "id": "r:4374002528"
    }
  ]
}
